name: § 1, after point i – 44
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council, the Commission and the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy on the 81st session of the United Nations General Assembly
part_text: (ib) reject confrontation based on doctrines of spheres of influence exercised by any power; reaffirm that such approaches are incompatible with the principles of sovereign equality of states, non-interference and self-determination enshrined in the UN Charter;
